# pip-audit exceptions. Each line below the comments is one advisory ID that CI
# deliberately does not fail on. Anything not listed here still fails the build.

# Package:  pillow 12.3.0 (transitive, via fastembed in the `rag` extra)
# Added:    23 October 2026, for the v1.0.0 release. Agreed by the team lead.
# Why:      All 35 advisories are fixed in pillow 13.0.0, but fastembed (latest
#           0.9.0) requires pillow<13, so the fix cannot be installed. The
#           project uses only fastembed's TextEmbedding and never decodes an
#           image: every input is Markdown or policy text. Pillow is imported
#           by fastembed but no project input reaches its image decoders.
# Remove:   As soon as a fastembed release allows pillow>=13. Then delete this
#           block, upgrade, and let pip-audit run clean.
